editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Fusion Markets is an ASIC-regulated broker scoring 7.6/10 from NAFT in 2026. Zero account at 0.0 pips + $4.50 RT is the cheapest ASIC-regulated ECN commission available — beating IC Markets, Pepperstone, and FP Markets. Full platform suite (MT4, MT5, cTrader, TradingView) with built-in copy trading. $0 minimum deposit and zero fees. Limited by its 2017 founding date and single Tier-1 licence. Best for cost-obsessed traders who want the absolute cheapest regulated execution.
